title: Prose Idylls, New and Old
author: Charles Kingsley
description: "Prose Idylls, New and Old" by Charles Kingsley is a collection of essays written in the late 19th century that reflects on nature, culture, and the simplicity of rural life.
longDescription: Through his prose, Kingsley explores themes of ecology, the changing relationship between humanity and nature, and the nostalgic yearning for the connection to the seasons that has been lost in the modern world.

authorInfo.bio: Charles Kingsley (1819–1875) wrote The Heroes; Or, Greek Fairy Tales for My Children. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
